# Stock Market Data MCP

Part of the **FoundryNet Data Network**.

Real-time stock quotes, OHLCV price history, options chains, sector performance,
and a stock screener for agents — Yahoo Finance data, refreshed every 30 minutes.

- `quote` / `batch_quote` (≤10) / `sector_performance` — **free**
- `price_history` ($0.01) / `options_chain` ($0.02) / `screener` ($0.01) — paid (x402, USDC on Solana)
- `batch_quote` over 10 tickers — $0.005/extra ticker
- `daily_brief` ($20) — curated daily movers, sectors, and 52-week highs/lows
- `mint_info` — network + MINT Protocol cross-promo (free)

Paid tools give 50 free queries/day per agent; an `Authorization: Bearer fnet_` key bypasses payment.

## Live network activity

**Live feed:** [mint.foundrynet.io/feed](https://mint.foundrynet.io/feed)  
Real-time verified work across the FoundryNet Data Network and autonomous agents, anchored on Solana via [MINT Protocol](https://mint.foundrynet.io).
